thread:
maria: quick favor — can someone spin up a smoke + steady-state bench for perseus-7b-v2 using triton int8? goal: verify baseline perf + check for memory fragmentation / eviction noise. target config: workers=8, seq=2048, burst=16. post short summary + s3 link. thx :pray:
jonah: on it, taking the run slot now. will try batch sizes 4/8/16 and post patch notes.
bench-bot: queued run id run-1755559999-perseus-int8. estimated runtime ~12m.
bench-bot: run complete — artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/perseus/1755559999/ (index.html + raw.json + profile.tgz)
maria: awesome — can someone paste the short table (p50/p95/p99, tps, mem peak)? want to decide canary rollout tomorrow.
bench-bot: summary (steady-state window):
```
model: perseus-7b-v2 (int8/triton)
workers: 8, seq: 2048, batch: 8
throughput: 2,100 tokens/s (aggregate)
latency per-token p50: 22ms, p95: 65ms, p99: 140ms
gpu mem peak per worker: 23.6GB
observed evictions: intermittent (0.07 eviction_rate)
notable: single OOM on worker-3 during warmup, retried and passed
artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/perseus/1755559999/
```
jonah: notes: batch=4 lowers p99 a bit but throughput drops ~12%. batch=16 increases throughput ~8% but p99 spikes to ~220ms and eviction_rate goes up. looks like sweet spot around 8 for this profile.
ev an: saw the OOM on worker-3 — I pulled the profile. there are repeated small alloc failures around long-context decode. log snippet:
```
[2024-04-12T15:12:03Z] WARN kvcache: eviction pressure rising (rate=0.09)
[2024-04-12T15:12:05Z] ERROR triton_allocator: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (alloc 1.2GiB)
```
kevin: @evan can you try repro with --alloc-strategy=compact and --kvcache-size=1.6GB? could be fragmentation under triton allocator.
ev an: will repro. quick command I used to reproduce locally:
```
rdw-bench run --model perseus-7b-v2 --backend triton --quant int8 \
  --workers 8 --batch 8 --seq 2048 --warmup 60 --steady 120 \
  --alloc-strategy compact --kvcache-size 1.6G
```
ev an: repro notes: with compact allocator the OOM didn't occur in two runs and p99 dropped ~20ms. eviction_rate also dropped to 0.03. suspect default allocator + big batch causes fragmentation.
maria: great find. can we add a short canary policy: default to batch=8 + alloc-strategy=compact for canary, and leave global default unchanged until we validate across different host types?
rachael: sounds good — I'll add a note to the onboarding checklist and the release doc. also adding a follow-up item to run on A100 vs L40i to ensure parity.
jonah: also flagged a perf-regression tag in the run metadata: regression_vs-baseline=+12% p99 on batch=16. saved as run-1755559999-metrics.json in artifacts.
kevin: FYI ops-bot reported minor thermal throttling on host-3 during the run window, which might amplify tail noise. ops-bot log:
```
ops-bot: host-3: GPU_TEMP spike 87C -> fan ramped, power limit throttled briefly
```
jonah: action list: 1) update canary config (batch=8, alloc=compact), 2) re-run smoke across A100/L40i nodes, 3) investigate bundling compact allocator as an opt-in for int8 triton models. i'll open the PR for canary config.
maria: thanks all. @evan @kevin please follow up on the allocator PR and the repro on different hosts. will wait for the cross-host numbers before promoting. :thumbsup:
ev an: will post repro logs + diff in the run artifact path in a bit. :eyes:
bench-bot: posted detailed profile at s3://redwood-bench/perseus/1755559999/profile.tgz
rachael: added onboarding note here: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/models#perseus-7b-v2 (draft)
maria: closing this thread — we have what we need to decide canary config. will ping when ready for rollout. :sparkles:
